action.summary: Research Integration G product completeness and closure-currentness so product readiness cannot be forged by caller-selected or incomplete current refs.
forbiddenActions: treat current SemanticClaimHead or ObligationHead scans as completeness proof without a canonical completeness subject
introduce a global scheduler or organization workflow
reuse a historical ProductOutcomeClaim as a permanent DONE bit

hardInvariants: research reduces uncertainty; it does not mutate product source
ProductStateProjection is derived/rebuildable and cannot be source of truth
caller-selected current claim/obligation lists cannot establish completeness
historical ProductOutcomeClaim is not a permanent current DONE bit
closure must bind exact current product-state and policy subjects and fail closed on currentness races
Integration G must compose with Integration C semantic currentness and E/F exact QualityAcceptance without inventing a second independent truth system
researchQuestion: what canonical subject proves the complete closure-relevant product history/current set?
how should product-level history compose with per-subject claim/obligation currentness without contradictory sources of truth?
how can projection be deterministic/rebuildable and resist omission attacks?
what exact currentness handshake prevents closure against a stale product state?
how should post-closure supersession preserve historical closure while making it non-current?
expectedOutputs: bounded research artifact with evidence, failure modes, rejected alternatives and SA-ready decision surface
explicit recommendation for product-history completeness and closure-currentness semantics
